title: Pure Golden Castle of Stromberg
summary: Pure Golden Castle of Stromberg fairy-tale beatdown and banish OTK build, pairing Leon von Schroeder's iconic storybook characters with Gren Maju Da Eiza and staples. The deck cheats out high-impact fairy-tale monsters each turn while turning the castle's massive 10-card face-down maintenance banish into gargantuan ATK for Gren Maju Da Eiza and lethal direct assaults.

summary.title: Starters
points: Glife the Phantom Bird discards itself from hand to search Golden Castle of Stromberg directly from your Deck, and destroys an opponent's Spell or Trap if Normal or Special Summoned.
Terraforming searches Golden Castle of Stromberg to guarantee Field Spell access on turn 1.
Golden Castle of Stromberg Special Summons any monster mentioning it directly from your Deck once per turn during your Main Phase, bypassing Normal Summon requirements.
Iron Hans Special Summons Iron Knight from your Deck upon Normal or Special Summon, generating an instant Rank 4 Xyz body.

summary.title: Opening: Glife the Phantom Bird
steps: Discard Glife the Phantom Bird to add Golden Castle of Stromberg from your Deck to your hand.
Activate Golden Castle of Stromberg in your Field Zone.
Use Golden Castle's Main Phase effect to Special Summon Iron Hans directly from your Deck.
Iron Hans triggers on Special Summon to summon Iron Knight from your Deck (without locking your Extra Deck, since Golden Castle is on the field).
Overlay Iron Hans and Iron Knight to Xyz Summon Number 41: Bagooska the Terribly Tired Tapir, Tornado Dragon, or Time Thief Redoer.
Normal Summon Gren Maju Da Eiza (or Hexe Trude without Tributing under Golden Castle).

summary.title: The Banish Synergy & Castle Defense
points: Golden Castle of Stromberg requires you to banish 10 cards face-down from the top of your Deck during each of your Standby Phases as maintenance.
Gren Maju Da Eiza gains 400 ATK and DEF for every banished card you own, surging to 4000 ATK after a single Golden Castle maintenance or Pot of Desires, and 8000+ ATK with both.
When an opponent's monster declares an attack while Golden Castle is active, the attacking monster is automatically destroyed and the opponent takes damage equal to half its ATK.
Pumpkin Carriage allows Prinzessin to attack directly, and while Golden Castle is active, completely protects the Field Spell from being targeted or destroyed by card effects.

summary.title: Bosses & Removal
points: Hexe Trude can be Normal Summoned without Tributing while Golden Castle is active, destroys 1 card on the field once per turn, and can make a second attack while gaining 400 ATK upon destroying an opponent's monster.
Number 38: Hope Harbinger Dragon Titanic Galaxy and Dingirsu, the Orcust of the Evening Star are accessed via Level 8 Hexe Trude bodies, providing Spell negation and non-targeting removal.
Iron Cage sends an opponent's monster to the GY while Golden Castle is active, temporarily locking it away before returning it to the field.
Prinzessin equips Glass Slippers to an opponent's monster when inflicting direct damage, reducing its ATK by 1000 and preventing it from attacking.

allow.Gren Maju Da Eiza: Level 3 Fiend that gains 400 ATK/DEF for each of your banished cards—gaining +4000 ATK/DEF every time Golden Castle of Stromberg's 10-card Standby Phase maintenance resolves!
allow.Pot of Desires: Banishes 10 cards from the top of your Deck face-down to draw 2 cards, adding another +4000 ATK to Gren Maju Da Eiza while digging for Glife or Golden Castle.
allow.Terraforming: Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Golden Castle of Stromberg directly from the Deck.
allow.Reinforcement of the Army: Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Level 4 Warriors Iron Hans or Iron Knight.
allow.Number 38: Hope Harbinger Dragon Titanic: Rank 8 Xyz summoned using Level 8 Hexe Trude that negates Spells and redirects attacks.
allow.Dingirsu, the Orcust of the Evening Star: Rank 8 Xyz summoned using Level 8 Hexe Trude that sends an opponent's card to the GY without targeting and protects cards from destruction.
allow.Number 41: Bagooska the Terribly Tired T: Rank 4 stall boss made with Iron Hans + Iron Knight.
allow.Tornado Dragon: Rank 4 Quick Effect Spell/Trap destruction made with Iron Hans + Iron Knight.
allow.Time Thief Redoer: Rank 4 Xyz that detaches materials to spin opposing cards and banish itself as a Quick Effect.
allow.Number 97: Draglubion: Rank 8 Dragon Xyz that summons Number 38 or Number 100 directly from the Extra Deck.

main: Glife the Phantom Bird

Level 4 WIND Winged Beast that discards itself from the hand to add 1 'Golden Castle of Stromberg' from your Deck to your hand, and destroys 1 Spell/Trap your opponent controls on Normal or Special Summon.
Hexe Trude

Level 8 DARK Spellcaster boss (2600 ATK) that can be Normal Summoned without Tributing while Golden Castle of Stromberg is on the field, destroys 1 card on the field per turn while Stromberg is up, and attacks a second time while gaining 400 ATK on battle destruction.
Prinzessin

Level 4 LIGHT Fairy that cannot be attacked by Level 4+ monsters, gains 300 ATK per turn, and Special Summons Pumpkin Carriage from hand/Deck; if she inflicts direct battle damage while Golden Castle is up, she equips Glass Slippers directly from your Deck to an opponent's monster!
Pumpkin Carriage

Level 3 EARTH Plant that allows Prinzessin to attack directly, and while Golden Castle of Stromberg is in the Field Zone, makes Golden Castle of Stromberg immune to card effect destruction and targeting!
Iron Hans

Level 4 EARTH Warrior that Special Summons Iron Knight from your Deck when Normal/Special Summoned (locking Extra Deck only if Golden Castle is NOT on the field!), and gains 1000 ATK while Golden Castle is active.
Iron Knight

Level 4 EARTH Warrior summoned by Iron Hans; loses 1000 ATK while you control Iron Hans, and searches any 'Iron Hans' or Spellcaster monster that mentions Golden Castle of Stromberg (Hexe Trude!) when destroyed by battle or card effect.
Gren Maju Da Eiza
Gains 400 ATK/DEF per banished card, reaching 4000 ATK after 1 Golden Castle Standby Phase or Pot of Desires, and 8000 ATK after both!
Golden Castle of Stromberg

Signature Field Spell: banishes 10 cards face-down from your Deck each Standby Phase, Special Summons any monster that mentions it directly from your Deck during your Main Phase, and automatically destroys any opponent's monster that declares an attack while burning for half its ATK!
Glass Slippers
Equip Spell that gives a Fairy +1000 ATK, OR when equipped to a non-Fairy (an opponent's monster via Prinzessin's direct attack!), prevents that monster from attacking and lowers its ATK by 1000!
Iron Cage
Continuous Spell that sends 1 monster you control to the GY (or 1 opponent's monster if Golden Castle of Stromberg is in the Field Zone!) and revives it during your next Standby Phase.
Pot of Desires
Banishes 10 cards face-down to draw 2 cards and fuel Gren Maju Da Eiza.
Terraforming
Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Golden Castle of Stromberg.
Reinforcement of the Army
Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Iron Hans.
